introduction.stringValue: Join Bayani for a new investigation. Explore the clues, explain your choices and learn how goods, technologies, and cultural exchange connects with Philippine history. The situations in this lesson are fictional teaching examples, not accounts of named historical events.

lessonRecap.stringValue: Goods could meet different needs. Pots could hold things, while cloth could have everyday and social uses. Technology includes practical ways of doing things, not just modern machines. Boatbuilding, weaving and pottery use knowledge and tools. People meeting through travel could share language, skills and beliefs. Cultural exchange can move in more than one direction. Communities were not passive copies of visitors. People made choices about goods and practices. A report should say what its clues support and what they do not show. An object is not a complete record of an encounter.
